8 COMPONENTS
Recovery rules

If the database commit succeeds but RQ submission fails, the saved run needs a manual retry.

Pub/Sub notices are transient. A crash after commit can prevent a notice. FastAPI reads saved events on reconnect to recover missed updates. It subscribes before replay. The live path uses no routine database polling.

The model API and React dashboard are planned. This explorer shows the proposed design.
